fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reported Q3 earnings below consensus for the first time since 2023, but raised its 2026 net interest income guidance to $10.62 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company is pursuing a strategy of reducing share buybacks, increasing dividends, and focusing on technology and AI investments, sacrificing near-term profits to secure long-term profitability.
fields.summary_ko.2: Based on 2029 consensus, revenue is projected at $22.71 billion and net income at $6.88 billion, representing an increase of $5.2 billion from current levels, although margin pressure risks exist if credit deteriorates and interest rates rise.
